verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API (growthbook-docs-12) and an official MCP server that makes authenticated REST calls for AI tools such as Cursor and Claude (growthbook-docs-13, growthbook-docs-21, growthbook-probe-3). It also documents draft revisions with review requests and required approval before publishing (growthbook-docs-5), with approval workflows listed as an Enterprise-tier feature (growthbook-docs-16, growthbook-docs-37). Missing for 10: explicit evidence that changes made via API/MCP are forced through the approval flow rather than bypassing it, a documented CLI, a reachable OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration, and availability on non-Enterprise tiers.
